title: Intel, CEO and CFO sued by shareholders over alleged concealment before 28.6% stock plunge
summary: Intel, CEO Lip-Bu Tan and CFO David Zinsner are facing a shareholder class action alleging they concealed weak PC demand and inventory buildup before an Oct. 29, 2026, fourth-quarter revenue and profit forecast that fell short of expectations. The forecast was followed by a 28.6% one-day stock plunge and about $140 billion in lost market value; the suit, led by a Michigan pension fund, has a proposed class period of July 23 to Oct. 29, 2026.
